agent_explanation: Large velocity error (rest to ~13.4 m/s toward distant waypoint) demands ~kp*m*|err|~348N > fmax 111.3N. Without noise the controller clamps exactly to fmax (observed 111.335 in counterfactual). With noise=0.209 the reported force is 144.736 > fmax, i.e. seeded sensor noise is added after the fmax clamp (or noisy error is not re-clamped), allowing the limit to be exceeded on the very first step.
